courses.overview: 依接口學習相近工法：凸塊共面性、電流密度與界面可靠度。每個比較保留共同機制及不可直接轉移的邊界。
courses.overviewEn: Learn related methods through interfaces: Bump coplanarity, current density and interface reliability. Each comparison retains both shared mechanisms and nontransferable boundaries.

related.title: 熱壓接合
related.why: 共面性與焊料體積決定熱壓接合的接觸分布
related.whyEn: Coplanarity and solder volume determine contact distribution during thermocompression
related.transfer: 共面性與焊料體積決定熱壓接合的接觸分布
related.transferEn: Coplanarity and solder volume determine contact distribution during thermocompression
related.difference: 本課形成凸塊，熱壓課研究受力與接合後界面
related.differenceEn: This course forms bumps; thermocompression studies loading and bonded interfaces
practice: 以「焊墊與凸塊座標」畫出兩課的材料或資料交接，標明共同基準。
比較「焊墊開口、凸塊中心與封裝對位誤差須同一座標系，局部偏心會縮小有效接合面。」在另一工法下還缺少哪項邊界條件。
用本課的「疊合設計輪廓與量測中心，分開平移、旋轉與非線性殘差。」設計一項可轉移和一項不可直接轉移的驗收證據。
practiceEn: Use pad and bump coordinates to draw material/data handoffs and shared datums.

Identify missing boundary conditions when applying this mechanism to the other process: Pad openings, pillar centers and assembly overlay need one coordinate system; local eccentricity reduces useful contact area.
Using "Overlay design contours and measured centers; separate translation, rotation and nonlinear residuals.", define one transferable and one nontransferable acceptance item.

related.title: 重佈線層微影與電鍍
related.why: 兩者皆須連續種子層、圖形電鍍與去種子層
related.whyEn: Both require continuous seed, patterned plating and seed removal
related.transfer: 兩者皆須連續種子層、圖形電鍍與去種子層
related.transferEn: Both require continuous seed, patterned plating and seed removal
related.difference: 凸塊控制高度與頂面，RDL 控制線寬、厚度與跨材料應力
related.differenceEn: Pillars control height and topography; RDL controls width, thickness and cross-material stress
practice: 以「銅微結構」畫出兩課的材料或資料交接，標明共同基準。
比較「晶粒與雜質影響延展、電阻與後續熱循環；室溫電阻正常並不排除脆化界面。」在另一工法下還缺少哪項邊界條件。
用本課的「將電阻、截面與熱處理前後微結構配對，保持樣本位置可追溯。」設計一項可轉移和一項不可直接轉移的驗收證據。
practiceEn: Use copper microstructure to draw material/data handoffs and shared datums.

Identify missing boundary conditions when applying this mechanism to the other process: Grains and impurities affect ductility, resistance and thermal cycling; normal room-temperature resistance does not exclude embrittlement.
Using "Pair resistance, cross-section and pre/post-thermal microstructure with traceable sampling positions.", define one transferable and one nontransferable acceptance item.
